The combined 'Nonmajor Enterprise' column of the proprietary funds statement (p9, printed p25) in detail (indices 171-182; 12 lines) is replaced by one line per printed non-zero row of each individual fund column (Total Nonmajor Enterprise column not used; Printing Services and Graphics and Levi Carter Park print only dashes this year; Capital expense prints only dashes). Row by row the fund cells add up to the combined line removed: Charges for services 1,199,283 + 480,867 + 7,266,147 + 534,156 = 9,480,453; Gain or loss on sale (Tranquility Park) 118,508 = 118,508 (p9 'Gain (loss) on sale of capital assets'); Personal service 517,603 + 144,836 + 3,532,267 + 520,552 = 4,715,258; Employer pension expense (reduction) -20,218 + 16,205 + 373,470 + 69,921 = 439,378; Employer OPEB expense (reduction) 6,018 + 2,006 + 34,100 + 10,031 = 52,155; Outside services 150,586 + 346,455 + 41,724 + 1,293,475 + 20,129 = 1,852,369; Operation and maintenance 300,512 + 11,377 + 1,429,151 + 143,414 = 1,884,454; Cost of sales and service 9,105 + 23,020 + 505,543 = 537,668; Depreciation and amortization 59,254 + 165,834 + 66,690 + 495,905 + 5,122 = 792,805; Interest expense (Golf Operations) 30,889 = 30,889. Transfers: the p9 combined column nets the transfer between nonmajor enterprise funds (City Wide Sports Revenue Transfers in 55,139 from Tennis Operations Transfers out (55,139)); the combining page prints them gross (Total Nonmajor Enterprise Transfers in 59,385, Transfers out (406,830)). Gross per fund: Transfers in 55,139 (City Wide Sports Revenue) + 4,246 (Marinas) = 59,385 = combined 4,246 + 55,139; Transfers out (55,139) (Tennis Operations) + (351,691) (Golf Operations) = (406,830) = combined (351,691) + (55,139). Net transfers 59,385 - 406,830 = -347,445 = 4,246 - 351,691. The per-fund gross transfers replace the two netted lines. 39 lines added, 12 removed; every non-transfer row nets to 0. Labels, sections, signs, categories and function as on the removed combined lines (expenses positive, printed credits in parentheses negative; interest expense a positive expenditure; gain on sale in revenue; transfers out negative); printed_label = the combining-page row text.
